metadata.shortDescription: Find a target in a shifted sorted hallway by reading as few rooms as possible.

story.premise: A sorted vault hallway has been cracked and rotated by a timequake.
story.victoryText: The vault stabilizes around the found relic.
story.failureText: The hallway keeps shifting. Replay the path and fix the search.

quests.title: Quest 1: Read a calm hallway
quests.brief: Before the timequake, practice finding the relic in a normal sorted hallway.
quests.learningGoal: Use left, right, and mid to cut a sorted search space in half.
quests.signature: def find_plain(nums: List[int], target: int) -> int:

hints.text: Which two edges describe the search window?
After reading the middle room, which half can be ignored?

solution.explanation: Each peek at the middle room removes half of the remaining hallway. If the window closes, the relic is absent.

quests.title: Quest 2: Find the timequake cliff
quests.brief: Locate the index where the shifted hallway drops back to the smallest room.
quests.learningGoal: Use binary search against the right edge to find the rotation pivot.

hints.text: If the middle room is greater than the right edge, which side contains the cliff?
What does it mean when the middle room is less than or equal to the right edge?

solution.explanation: The cliff is always on the unsorted side. Comparing mid to the right edge tells which side still contains the smallest room.

quests.title: Quest 3: Pick the stable half
quests.brief: At each split, identify whether the left or right stretch is sorted and whether the relic could be there.
quests.learningGoal: Decide which side of a rotated array can still contain the target.
quests.signature: def choose_half(nums: List[int], target: int) -> str:

hints.text: Which side is sorted when nums[l] <= nums[mid]?
Once you know a side is sorted, how do you test whether target fits inside it?

solution.explanation: One side of the split is always sorted. Search it only if the target fits between its endpoints; otherwise take the other side.

boss.title: Boss: Stabilize the Rotated Vault
boss.brief: Return the index of the target relic, or -1 if it is absent.

solution.explanation: At every step, one side of the rotated hallway is sorted. Use that sorted side to decide whether the target could be there, then discard half.
